children: AP (Thailand) looks better positioned than its peers to withstand margin pressure, ttb wealth securities' Rata Limsuthiwanpoom says in a research report. Amid the current trend of flight to quality Thai property developers, the company's stronger presales momentum should enable it to avoid aggressive inventory destocking at low prices, the analyst says. AP (Thailand)'s presales grew 16% in 1H versus average 2% contraction of top 12 listed residential developers. The brokerage sees the company as cheapest choice in Thailand's property sector, trading at only estimated 4.7x 2027 price-to-earnings. It raises the stock's target price to 11.50 baht from 10.00 baht to reflect valuation roll-over with an unchanged buy rating. Shares are unchanged at 8.10 baht. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
